name: config/__init__.py
summary: Initializes and exports the backend configuration package, providing centralized access to application settings
purpose: Serves as the unified entry point for the configuration layer, abstracting the underlying settings modules and ensuring that the application loads, validates, and exposes configuration consistently across all backend services
responsibilities: Expose primary configuration classes and instances to the application
Centralize imports from environment-specific settings modules
Initialize configuration loading and validation logic
Provide a stable interface for accessing application-wide settings
Orchestrate default and environment-based configuration resolution
outputs: Exported settings interfaces for import by other modules
architecture_notes: Functions as a Facade for the configuration subsystem, decoupling the rest of the application from the internal structure of settings modules. Typically implements a singleton-like access pattern for the active configuration instance and may integrate with libraries such as Pydantic Settings or python-decouple for type-safe, environment-driven configuration management. This file defines the boundary between infrastructure/environment concerns and domain logic.
improvements: Add explicit __all__ definition to control the public API surface
Implement structured logging for configuration source resolution and load failures
Introduce lazy initialization to defer heavy I/O until first access
Add runtime configuration validation with detailed error messages
Consider namespacing exports to prevent polluting the global package namespace
